subject: Quick thought for greenlitcontent.com — Growing Team  /  Scaling Challenges
body:
Hi there,

I came across greenlitcontent.com and noticed you mention local business, founder on your site.

I build focused automations for local service businesses, and growing team  /  scaling challenges tends to be one of the biggest time sinks I see.

For a business like yours, I'd recommend starting with a single high-impact build:
- Workflow Automation Retainer — Ongoing Optimization
- Turnaround: ongoing (fixed scope, no long-term contract)
- Investment: $1,000-$2,000/mo

No monthly retainers, no lock-in. Just a working tool that replaces the repetitive part of your workflow.

If this sounds useful, I can send a quick demo of a comparable build so you can see exactly what's possible.

Best,
MECOS Automation
